item.title: Law and Order: Man convicted of child rape in 2017 at age 17 accused of newly reported rape three years earlier
item.description: Leonard Hahn Leonard Hahn IV, 26, of Walnut Street, Albany, is charged with rape in the first degree. Hahn was arrested on Jan. 29 and arraigned in Genesee County Court. He is accused of a sex offense that occurred in the Town of Alabama during the summer of 2014. Bail was placed at $100,000 cash, $200,000 insurance bond, and $300,000 partially secured bond on the new charges. Hahn is scheduled to appear in Genesee County Court on Feb. 18 at 2 p.m.
